steps.say: The International Federation of Gynecology and Obstetrics unveiled an updated staging system for endometrial carcinoma in 2023 that bridges anatomical surgical findings with molecular genetics.
steps.tx: The revolutionary **FIGO 2023** staging system for endometrial carcinoma formally incorporates histological subtyping, tumor differentiation grade, presence of **substantial LVSI**, and genomic **molecular integration** directly into surgical stage categorization, refining prognostic discrimination and modern adjuvant treatment allocation for all patients.

steps.say: In the 2023 FIGO staging classification, Stage I is partitioned into three distinct subcategories based on the depth of myometrial invasion and specific anatomical findings.
steps.tx: **Stage IA1** designates non-aggressive endometrioid tumors confined to the endometrium or a polyp. **Stage IA2** involves **myometrial invasion <50%** with absent or focal LVSI. **Stage IA3** encompasses **concurrent ovarian low-grade** endometrioid carcinomas that fulfill stringent criteria for dual independent primaries rather than metastatic spread.

rows: Confined to endometrial mucosa or polyp

steps.say: Stage IB and Stage IC disease reflect deeper muscle infiltration and high-risk histological phenotypes that predict heightened risks of systemic dissemination.
steps.tx: **Stage IB** represents non-aggressive histological types demonstrating **myometrial invasion >=50%** without extensive vascular permeation. Conversely, **Stage IC** denotes **aggressive histological types** such as serous carcinoma, clear cell carcinoma, carcinosarcoma, or mesonephric-like adenocarcinomas confined entirely to the uterine corpus without extrauterine extension.

left.title: Stage IB (Deep Invasion Non-Aggressive)
points: Absent or only focal lymphovascular space invasion

right.title: Stage IC (Aggressive Histologies)
points: Uterine serous carcinoma, clear cell, or carcinosarcoma
Confined to uterus regardless of depth of invasion
Carries high intrinsic risk of microscopic dissemination

steps.say: Cervical stromal extension and prominent lymphovascular invasion substantially elevate recurrence hazards and dictate upstaging to FIGO Stage II.
steps.tx: Under FIGO 2023, **Stage IIA cervical stroma** invasion is defined by macroscopic or microscopic glandular and stromal involvement. **Stage IIB substantial LVSI** recognizes unequivocal widespread vascular space invasion as a Stage II equivalent, while **Stage IIC aggressive myometrium** denotes aggressive histologies invading any degree of myometrium.

rows: Invasion of cervical stromal connective tissue
Equated to Stage II even if organ-confined
Upstaged due to high distant failure risk

steps.say: Regional lymphatic dissemination represents the most important prognostic factor in apparent early-stage endometrial cancer, subdividing into pelvic and para-aortic groups.
steps.tx: Lymph node metastasis is staged as Stage IIIC: **Stage IIIC1** denotes pelvic lymph node metastasis, whereas **Stage IIIC2** signifies para-aortic lymph node involvement. Pathological staging further differentiates nodal tumor burden into **micrometastasis (i)** measuring 0.2 to 2 mm and **macrometastasis (ii)** exceeding 2 mm.

nodes.label: Perform sentinel lymph node mapping and ultrastaging
Isolated tumor cells (<=0.2 mm): Stage I/II (record as N0[i+])
Micrometastasis (>0.2 mm to <=2 mm): assign Stage IIIC1i or IIIC2i
Macrometastasis (>2 mm): assign Stage IIIC1ii or IIIC2ii

steps.say: Standard comprehensive surgical staging remains the cornerstone of initial endometrial cancer management for all medically operable candidates.
steps.tx: Comprehensive primary **surgical staging** comprises total extrafascial abdominal or laparoscopic **extrafascial hysterectomy**, bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy (**BSO**), peritoneal washings for cytology, and targeted bilateral nodal evaluation via fluorescent **sentinel lymph node mapping** using indocyanine green (ICG) to detect occult metastases. Multidisciplinary tumour board review ensures optimal clinical staging and coordinates tailored surgical oncological interventions.

left.title: Core Surgical Components
points: Peritoneal washings obtained immediately upon entry

right.title: Nodal Staging Protocol
points: Systematic identification of sentinel nodes bilaterally
Mandatory pathologic ultrastaging with cytokeratin IHC

steps.say: The route of surgical access for endometrial cancer staging has shifted decisively toward minimally invasive approaches over the past two decades.
steps.tx: The definitive **minimally invasive staging** standard of care was established by the randomized **LAP2 trial** (GOG) and the international **LACE trial**. These prospective trials proved that laparoscopic or **robotic hysterectomy** achieves equivalent disease-free and overall survival compared to open laparotomy while dramatically lowering blood loss and wound complications.

left.title: Minimally Invasive Surgery (LAP2 & LACE Standard)
points: Equivalent 5-year overall survival and recurrence rates
Significantly lower intraoperative blood loss and wound infections
Shorter hospital stays (1-2 days vs 4-6 days for laparotomy)

right.title: Open Laparotomy
points: Reserved for massive uteri, extensive adhesions, or peritoneal spread
Higher rate of wound dehiscence and postoperative incisional hernia
Longer post-operative recovery before adjuvant systemic therapy

steps.say: In patients presenting with aggressive high-risk histological variants, surgical staging must include examination and removal of the greater omentum.
steps.tx: Routine infra-colic **omentectomy** is mandatory for aggressive histologies including uterine **serous carcinoma**, clear cell carcinoma, and uterine **carcinosarcoma**. These variants share ovarian-like peritoneal tropism, yielding a **15-20% occult omental disease** rate even in the absence of macroscopic peritoneal abnormality during surgical exploration.
